headline: CHC @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 6.01 at COL 5.04, with a projected total of 11.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: CHC moved +0.29 runs while COL moved +1.07, changing the projected margin by -0.78 runs. The projected total climbed +1.37, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Tomoyuki Sugano has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Tyler Freeman, Troy Johnston, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chad Stevens, Kevin Alcántara because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
